law_name: Data Protection Act 2011 (Act No. 11 of 2011) as amended by Act 2 of 2015
scope: Data subjects (individuals) whose personal data is processed
key_requirements: Express consent of the data subject before processing; notification of processing by controllers; access requests answered within 30 days (ss. 52-53); direct-marketing stop right (s. 57)
penalties_range: General offence: fine up to XCD 10000 for individuals and up to XCD 100000 for bodies corporate
exemptions: Part VI: national security, crime and taxation, health and social work, regulatory activities, journalism literature and art, research history and statistics (s. 63), publicly available information; s. 65 legal disclosures
research_exemption: Part VI exempts research, history and statistics (s. 63)
notes: Only partly in force: S.I. 4/2023 commenced Part I, ss. 32-43, Part VI and Schedule 2 (a)-(g) on 31 Jan 2023. Part II (Commissioner) not listed as commenced. Amending Act 2 of 2015 in force 13 Apr 2015 added privacy impact assessments.; Only partly in force: S.I. 4/2023 brought into force Part I, ss. 32-43 of Part III, Part VI and Schedule 2(a)-(g) on 31 Jan 2023. Commissioner provisions (Part 2) not confirmed commenced. Amendment Act 2 of 2015 dated 13 Apr 2015.
